# PRD/ADR/Brief Workflow Fixture

This fixture points tests and future product workflow validators at the durable
workflow effort under:

`docs/product-workflows/efforts/closed/prd-adr-brief-workflow/`

It is intentionally documentation-tier. It now points at the migrated durable
effort, whose history records the original `started` path through the effort
index and workflow state. The fixture proves the resumable artifact shape and
keeps tests aligned with the current durable status bucket.
